_comment: The open-source standard-cell libraries the ASIC flow offers (technology, then corner) in the SDC tab's clock dialog and the Settings. Only open-source PDKs are listed here; a foundry or educational PDK under a licence (TSMC, SAED, …) goes in <project>/pdks.json (same format; an entry with the same id replaces one here; "only": true hides these). Only entries whose files exist show. `globs`: Design Compiler .db files; `include`: a regex a file name must match; `default`: the corner (label) chosen when the technology is picked; `probe_ns`: the clock period the quick Fmax estimate starts from (a period the library cannot meet, tighter for a faster node); the corner label is the file name without what all its files share. The paths are this site's: change them in your project's pdks.json if your PDKs live elsewhere.
